title: acrostichum bicuspe
intro: Acrostichum bicuspe, commonly known as the mangrove fern, is a type of aquatic fern native to tropical regions. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Acrostichum bicuspe are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antifungal, and antiparasitic activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Acrostichum bicuspe include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
